subject: SIG intake: Acme Corp questionnaire — initial owners & next steps
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-corp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-corp.com, sarah.liu@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire request — Acme initial intake

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for agreeing to help us with the SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) for Acme. Attached is the completed SIG spreadsheet from our side (SIG_Template.xlsx) with a few clarifying notes in the "notes" column. Our security team would like Redwood to complete the vendor sections and provide supporting evidence where applicable.

Key timelines: ideally a first-pass completed draft by Nov 13 so our procurement and InfoSec review can proceed the following week. If any sections require longer lead time, please flag them and include estimated delivery dates.

Specifically we need:
- Section ownership mapping (who at Redwood will own each SIG section)
- Evidence pointers (policy docs, diagrams, reports) and any redaction constraints
- A point of contact for follow-up validation/testing calls

Please confirm receipt and assign internal owners so we can share the intake with our procurement team. Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Principal Security Analyst
Acme Corp
Attachment: SIG_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire request — Acme initial intake

Daniel — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. We received the SIG_Template.xlsx and started a pass-through.

Internal owner assignments (first pass):
- Access control & identity (IAM, RBAC): neha_kapoor (Security) — owner for answers + evidence
- Encryption & key management: dev_patel (Product) — owner for technical detail + KMS evidence
- Network & infra segmentation: vivek_kulkarni (Infra/Platform) — owner for diagrams and controls
- Privacy, data handling & retention: mina_haddad (Privacy/Compliance) — owner for retention policies and DPIA info
- Contractual / legal Qs: I'll coordinate with Legal but will surface redlines as needed (marissa_cole)

I've attached a living draft (redwood_sig_response_draft.xlsx) with initial responses where obvious and TODO placeholders where we need artifacts. Can everyone please review their assigned sections and reply with:
1) Confirmation you own the section
2) A short list of artifacts you will provide (or a note if the item is non-applicable)
3) Estimated completion date (we're aiming for Nov 13 for a full draft)

Also proposing a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow, Mon Nov 3 at 10am PT to triage any blockers — please reply if that conflicts.

Daniel — if you prefer a different owner mapping, let me know and we'll adjust.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_sig_response_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire request — Acme initial intake

Thanks Marissa — I'm happy to own Access Control & Identity. Quick note on evidence and assumptions so we can keep Acme informed:

Planned artifacts for Access Control (SIG sections):
- IAM policy excerpts (AWS IAM roles & policies) — will provide redacted JSON snippets
- Admin access matrix (who has super-admins across services) — sanitized table
- SSO configuration summary (Okta) and SAML metadata (screenshot/summary)
- MFA enforcement confirmation and related enforcement policy doc
- Recent access review cadence & sample report (redacted)

Other items that need coordination:
- SOC 2 report: Procurement often wants the latest opinion letter + testing period. Do we have the most recent SOC 2 Type II available for sharing? (Marissa, pls advise or loop Legal)
- Evidence indexing: I'll prepare an evidence_index.csv to track each artifact we attach and provide recommended redaction where needed.
- Some policy documents contain PII; we'll need to redact before sending to Acme.

Delivery plan: I can complete answers + attach artifacts for the Access Control sections by Nov 11 EOD. If Acme needs certain artifacts earlier for procurement, flag those.

Questions for Acme (cc'd Daniel):
- For security audit artifacts, do you prefer full documents under an NDA or redacted PDFs uploaded to a secure share?
- Any sections you want us to prioritize for an initial review?

I'll upload the evidence_index.csv to our secure drive and link it in this thread once it's ready.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Information Security
Redwood Inference
Attachment: evidence_index.csv (CSV stub)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
